title: AIが設計データの分析からCAD操作まで支援する「SOLIDWORKS 2027」
summary_original: ダッソー・システムズは、3D設計開発ソリューション「SOLIDWORKS」の最新バージョン「SOLIDWORKS 2027」を発表した。製品バリエーションの検討やボルト締結解析、データ管理に関する機能強化に加え、AIによるアセンブリのパフォーマンス分析やモデルの軽量化、設計変更に伴う影響範囲の確認など、設計業務を支援する機能を拡充した。

title: OpenAI、AIエージェントが代わりに支払う「ChatGPT Wallet」　カード番号は渡さず、購入ごとに生体認証
summary_original: OpenAIは、AIエージェント「dot」による決済機能「ChatGPT Wallet」を発表した。実際のカード情報を店舗に渡さず、購入ごとに生体認証を求める仕組みで安全性を確保する。米国のChatGPT Pro加入者向けに提供を開始した。将来は事前承認に基づく自律決済にも対応する計画。

title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
summary_original:
Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton.

title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
summary_original:
Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. Author Mike Major cautions against jumping to conclusions, however, noting that business cycle shifts and remote work trends could also explain the numbers.

title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
summary_original:
Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. On Terminal Bench, it scores 88.4 points, landing just behind Claude Opus 5. The sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips, and Meituan makes no mention of Nvidia GPUs.

summary_original:

title: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
summary_original:
Stanford researchers released Memorilla, an open-source memory system that compresses a document collection into 16 memory tokens for a frozen Qwen3-8B. It reaches 84.33% on FactKG using 108x fewer document tokens than full context.
